ExtraBar 1.3.2 – Team Up & Validate! 👥✅

✨ What's New

  • Teams Validation Process: Added a robust validation process for teams, ensuring team configurations are verified and consistent before applying changes!

🚀 What's Next?

This is just the beginning of our team features journey! We're working on exciting new team capabilities that will make ExtraBar even more powerful for collaborative workflows. Stay tuned!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraBar community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make – keep it coming! 💙
